findings: F1 rsoxs_schema_extract.yaml is not loaded anywhere and is broken as a standalone schema: it redeclares RSoXSMeasurement with slots photon_energy_eV/absorption_edge/polarization that are undefined in its closure; SchemaView.class_induced_slots('RSoXSMeasurement') raises ValueError. It also shares id/name 'rsoxs' with rsoxs_schema.yaml, so a registry keyed on schema id would collide. Contrary to README it does not import the overlay.

F2 bl1101_schema.yaml is never loaded by LinkML at runtime or in tests; only its path string is recorded. multi_kg.schema_path_for_graph result is stored on kg.schema_path (retrieval_agent.py:440) and never read.

F3 Extraction semantics depend on launch profile: compose/rsoxs-stack use rsoxs_schema.yaml; default local launcher, scripts/run.py, academy launchers, run_pipeline_cborg and build_kg.sh use matkg_schema.yaml, where RSoXSMeasurement does not exist, so 'RSoXS' categories map to whatever fuzzy/alias resolution yields (alias target RSoXSMeasurement is filtered by 'broad in self.classes', term_extractor/schema.py:244-246).

F4 Two divergent SchemaHelper implementations (term_extractor/schema.py vs extract_terms.py); the extract_terms copy lacks 23 category and 7 relation aliases. Same schema, different normalization outcomes depending on entrypoint.
F5 Schema paths are CWD-relative strings everywhere; SchemaView resolves imports relative to the schema file, but the initial path requires repo-root CWD.
F6 No schema fingerprint is bound to any artifact (KG JSON, terms JSON, manifests, indexes).
F7 Existing graphs and repair outputs contain categories/predicates outside every schema closure (Unknown, Instrument, Detector in literature, characterized_by, simulates, 'rel:' prefix).
F8 License mismatch: schemas say MIT, repository LICENSE.txt is LBNL BSD-style. Owner question; no change.
F9 No test protects RSoXSMeasurement is_a ExperimentalTechnique, nor loads rsoxs/bl1101 overlays via LinkML.

Q2 Which schema is authoritative for local-profile extraction: matkg_schema.yaml (current default) or rsoxs_schema.yaml (compose)? Current behavior is preserved until answered; the registry will record whichever was used.
Q3 Should the extract_terms.py SchemaHelper divergence be preserved as a distinct legacy behavior (build_kg.sh) or routed to term_extractor/schema.py (a behavior change needing its own review)?
Q4 Schema license (MIT) vs repository license: confirm.
Q5 xray_schema.yaml is not selected for xray graphs by multi_kg; register the mapping or leave unbound?
